mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate (measured by month-over-month increase in FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS has increased month-over-month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate (indicating a tightening monetary policy coinciding with labor market weakness) amplifies equity market risk aversion, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when FEDFUNDS and UNRATE both rise, with SPX 20-day returns positive in more than 50% of such periods, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of labor market cooling (UNRATE > 4.5%), a decline in manufacturing activity (INDPRO < 100.0) signals an impending recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE > 4.5% and INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate exceeding 1.3 million units per month (HOUST > 1300.0) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where HOUST > 1300.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in industrial production above 105.0 (INDPRO > 105.0) signals robust manufacturing activity and economic resilience, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO > 105.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly retail sales figure exceeding 480,000 million dollars (RSAFS > 480000.0) indicates strong consumer spending and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where RSAFS > 480000.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of economic expansion (GDPC1 > 16800.0), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals a potential slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where GDPC1 > 16800.0 and INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
